plan: Given my value is $20, I should bid close to my value to maximize the chance of winning while ensuring a positive profit. Since bids must be in $0.1 increments, I will bid slightly below my value to avoid overpaying in case of a tie. A bid of $19.9 ensures that I win against any bid lower than $19.9 and still maintain a profit if the second-highest bid is lower than $19.9.

My private value exceeds the maximum possible value, indicating a strong chance to win. To maximize profit, I should bid slightly above the expected average of others' maximum values, around $15. This ensures a win while avoiding an unnecessary high bid.

Given my value of $11, my goal is to maximize profit by winning the item at a cost lower than $11. To do this, I should bid slightly above the midpoint of my value, ensuring competitiveness while maintaining a profit margin. Bidding $8.5 balances the risk of overbidding and the chance of winning.
